thread:
Maria P: Quick retrospective — partner complaint about duplicate outreach during CloudMarketplace/HW co-sell last week. Need a tighter intake model.
Ajay R: Oof. Partner said they got three outreach emails in 48h. Not great for close motion.
Sophie L: I pulled the intake logs. Looks like simultaneous workers created claims before account_map reconciliation ran.
Tom K: Linked a small repro of the race: https://tiny.redwood/si-race-clip (read-only).
Maria P: Can we debounce the intake events? Some form of short lease or token to avoid double-assignment.
Sophie L: Yes — two options: 1) short-lease lock (5s) on account key, 2) deterministic tie-breaker: earliest webhook_id wins and others get flagged. Leaning to tie-breaker for simpler rollback.
Ajay R: Rules of Engagement draft ideas:
• Intake: first-claim wins.
• SI must file engagement request within 36h on #partnerships-review with rationale.
• Field ownership trumps only if account_map shows regional_field_own=true.
• Any overlapping outreach requires a single coordinated mailbox; no direct partner emails until ownership confirmed.
Tom K: I'll add an idempotency token to webhook processing and a reconcile cron at 02:00 UTC that cross-checks account_map against claims and marks duplicates with status=stale.
Partners Bot: NOTE: joint announcement window for Marketplace + HW partner closes 2026-03-01 — confirm ownership prior to that date.
Maria P: Also add auto-notify to partner-engagement lead when duplicates are marked stale for >12h.
Sophie L: I ran a quick audit: 18 claims in last 30 days with at least one near-simultaneous duplicate (within 10s). I'll post the CSV to Confluence.
Ajay R: I'll own the RoE doc and loop in Legal for partner-approved language. Draft will include acceptance criteria for co-sell motions (engagement SLAs, contact cadence, who owns partner comms).
Tom K: Implementation notes: webhook idempotency + short in-memory lock + nightly reconcile job. Will open PR with tests.
Maria P: Action list:
- @Sophie L: full log audit + CSV to Confluence (due 2026-02-20)
- @Tom K: implement webhook idempotency + reconcile cron (due 2026-02-22)
- @Ajay R: publish RoE + Legal review (due 2026-02-24)
Maria P: Scheduling 30m sign-off on 2026-02-25. Please add any other edge cases.
Sophie L: Edge case: partner-reported account duplicates where the CRM has merged records. Will include merge-check in audit.
Ajay R: Also propose an explicit "do-not-contact" flag partners can set for the overlap window.
Tom K: Noted. Will add a field to intake schema: do_not_contact_until (timestamp).
Maria P: Perfect. Thanks team :raised_hands: :thumbsup:
